We want you to love your Tumble! You can return or exchange your item(s) for any reason within 30 days of delivery. Tumble covers the shipping costs for the return, so sending an item back costs you nothing.

To be eligible for a refund or exchange, items must be in new and sellable condition, with no visible damage, stains, or pet hair. Please note that rug swatches are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. Additionally, we allow one exchange per item.

To get started, you can visit our Returns/Exchange Center:

US Orders: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/returns-and-exchanges
Canada Orders: https://www.tumbleliving.ca/pages/returns-and-exchanges

You'll just need your order number and the email address used for the purchase. Once you submit the form, we'll email you a prepaid FedEx return label. You can print this at home or take the QR code to a FedEx Office Print & Ship Center to have them print it for you.

Thank you for being with us as a customer. Feel free to reach out for with any other questions.❤️
